summary: Rewrote the makefile fragments (generated version.h rule, include paths, dependency files, link order and static linking, flag stamp for DEBUG switching, check that fails on any failure, install with PREFIX/DESTDIR and pc/man handling), deleted the stale hand-kept include/qs/ops.h, and fixed the warnings and bugs in the sources (strbuf, size parsing fallthrough/overflow, unused variables under NDEBUG, format specifiers, sign comparisons, switch coverage, prefix-minus precedence). Verified clean builds of every target at -j1/8/32, make check in release and debug, incremental rebuilds, a no-op second make, and the install tree.
